avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Annie Springs (6,020 ft) and Sevenmile Marsh (5,690 ft) 38 to 58 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: left May 3; earlier seasons: June 15 (2023), June 9 (2024), June 10 (2025)

evidence.name: Sevenmile Marsh
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: June 7 (2023), June 3 (2024), June 2 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Annie Springs (6,020 ft) and Sevenmile Marsh (5,690 ft).

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: 9.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 58.7 in (2023), 44.6 in (2024), 61.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Sevenmile Marsh
evidence.detail: 1.5 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 47.2 in (2023), 37.8 in (2024), 43.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 1 and May 19, carried from the melt-out dates at Annie Springs (6,020 ft) and Sevenmile Marsh (5,690 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Annie Springs
evidence.detail: melted out May 3, 158 ft below the pass; points to April 13 to May 28

evidence.name: Sevenmile Marsh
evidence.detail: melted out April 6, 488 ft below the pass; points to March 20 to May 10
